checks.name: Plainly titled estimate section appears in property details
Property detail initially focuses close, not a financial input
Utility default uses the existing size and construction-year data
Living-here and rental scenarios are separate visible results
Work setup is optional and no fake zero-minute result appears
Provenance distinguishes defaults from saved edits
Hover reveals the complete utility formula and limitations
Tooltip works with keyboard focus and Escape without closing the home
Utility edits recalculate live without replacing the input or its focus
The same edit subtracts utilities once from calculator cash flow
Utility edits persist per property in the existing workspace key
Expanded explanation remains open during edits
Manual estimate labels replace rather than add to the formula
Invalid utility input '' pauses saving and marks results stale
Invalid utility input '-1' pauses saving and marks results stale
Invalid utility input '1000001' pauses saving and marks results stale
A deliberate zero utility allowance is not treated as blank
Reset restores the formula and removes only this utility override
A dedicated workspace-wide setup opens with keyboard focus
Location setup explains fictional positions before entry
A blank label cannot save a pretend work location
Zero speed is invalid, rather than causing division by zero
Saving work settings returns to the home without losing unsaved notes
Same-city sample commute uses the disclosed grid calculation
Work setup is stored once, not in each property record
Commute is visibly not a real route and does not change dollar totals
Commute tooltip exposes distance, assumed speed and travel-time formula
Changing position and speed recalculates the estimate
Cancel preserves the saved setup and returns focus to the invoking control
Another home automatically reuses the work location without repeated entry
Distinct homes get distinct same-city illustrative distances
A second home does not inherit the first home utility override
Different-city homes do not invent intercity travel estimates
Reopening the original home restores its independent utility edit
Detail estimates follow the last valid calculator insurance edit
Edited calculator provenance is explicit in property details
Closing-cost changes cannot leak into the living-here monthly total
An invalid calculator draft does not overwrite the detail estimate
Utility edits inside a modal do not erase an invalid calculator field behind it
Duplex details disclose whole-building and both-unit income assumptions
Reinitialization with the saved store restores utilities and one global work setup
Actual backup download includes utility and work settings
Importing a pre-1.6 backup migrates safely with no commute or utility overrides
Importing the new backup restores both features through the real dialog
Malformed commute imports fail without replacing the workspace
Remote-work mode removes the address instead of storing stale private data
Turning commute off resets only work settings
Workspace settings expose the single reusable work location
Saving from workspace settings returns to workspace management
Location labels render as text, never HTML or remote resources
Custom homes get size/age utilities but no made-up coordinates
Deleting a custom property prunes its utilities without deleting work settings
Storage failure is visible while valid session-only calculations continue
Work location also works session-only when storage fails
Session-only utility and commute edits can still be exported
Full workspace reset clears all new inputs and keeps the 60 original homes
